notes: Loadout HUD: all your skills and passives now show in the top-left corner (Vampire Survivors style) with their levels; evolved skills get a gold frame
The full loadout is also shown on the pause screen (tap, hover or controller focus for details) and on the level-up screen
Rerolls: start every run with 1 reroll and earn +1 every 5 levels; reroll the level-up cards with the button, R on keyboard or Y on controller
Endless passives: maxed passives keep upgrading past their max (shown as e.g. Umbral Might +) with diminishing returns, so level-ups never run dry
Talent trees: every one of the 384 talents now has its own painted icon, tinted per tree, with ornate frames on capstones and clearer locked / available / ranked / maxed states
Jump animation: your hero hops on dodges, Blink, level-ups, chests and evolutions, and when you pick a class or race (cosmetic only)
